description: Invite a customer contact to the B2B store, as the B2B Customers page does: records an invitation and, once committed, emails the contact a link to set a password and sign in. The contact buys for the customer named by customerId (a customer business partner id; find it with lookup_business_partners) and sees that customer's prices and orders. The store must be set up and open, and the email must not already have a store login. The preview names the customer and store and warns when earlier invitations to the email are still waiting. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential with Write + storefront.execute and the Admin role.

customerId.description: The customer (business partner) id (GUID) the contact buys for.

email.description: The contact's email address; the invitation is sent here.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

name: invite_b2b_customer
title: Invite B2B Customer
